'''Hethan Romund''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Historian/Legends|scholar]] and one of the few individuals willing to share any information of the fallen [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. During her studies she met several individuals [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. They later teamed up to rescue her when she was kidnapped and forced to help a user of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] access the [[Dawn Temple]], an old [[Jedi temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]].
